# 答案引擎的引用与信任设计
...
2026 年 7 月

本文是横向主题文：对象不是单一产品，而是答案引擎里「引用呈现 → 溯源核验 → 信任建立 → 广告张力」这条设计链。单品细节以 Perplexity、夸克 为主，Google AI Overviews / AI Mode 只取信任与广告相关对照；交互范式与商业宏观对比见 AI 搜索 vs 传统搜索。

## 一、产品背景：为什么「引用」成了一等功能

答案引擎把结果页从「十条蓝链」改成「一段可直接使用的综合回答」。代价是：用户不再默认「自己点开网页核对」，却仍要判断「这句话能不能当真」。于是产品必须补上一层可核验的信任接口——引用与溯源。

对 PM 来说，这里的命题不是「要不要做 RAG」，而是：

- 陈述能否回到证据：用户能否从某一句结论跳到原始材料？
- 证据是否可比较：能否看到多个来源、时间与标题，而不是只剩一个黑盒摘要？
- 生成边界是否说清楚：用户是否知道这是 AI 综合，而非原文摘录或人工编辑？
- 商业信号是否污染答案：答案旁出现广告时，用户会不会怀疑结论本身被买断？

Perplexity 把自身定位为 answer engine，并把「逐句编号引用」当成核心交互，而不是页脚参考文献；夸克在搜索入口上叠「先检索、再综合、再回来源」的回答层，同样把编号引用做成可点击控件。两者路径不同，但对「信任靠引用承接」的判断一致。宏观上谁取代谁，留给姊妹文；本文只拆这套机制本身。

## 二、核心功能拆解：引用是答案里的交互控件

### 2.1 引用呈现的三层结构

横向对照三家可观察的设计，引用通常叠三层，缺一层信任就会掉一截：

层级 | 做什么 | Perplexity（案例已述） | 夸克（公开页观察） | Google 答案层（对照） 
---|---|---|---|---
句级锚点 | 结论与证据绑定 | 每句/每段后编号角标，点击进原始信源；引用是驱动生成的检索材料，而非事后堆砌 | 结论或段落后编号引用，点击打开对应来源页 | Overviews / Mode 保留链回网页；Deep Search 等能力强调带引用的长文输出 
来源面板 | 让用户比较材料 | 信源排序可见地偏好时效与社区信号；Focus 可限定学术/Reddit/YouTube 等池子 | 来源区展示网站、标题、日期；提供「全部来源」列表 | 摘要旁/下保留网页探索；Mode 官方强调仍提供 helpful links 
生成声明 | 校准预期 | 产品叙事本身是「综合答案 + 可核验引用」 | 明确标注「以上内容由AI生成」 | 广告侧另有 Sponsored 标注与（试点中的）独立解释层 

一句话：好的引用不是参考文献列表，而是嵌在答案里的可点击控件——用户边读结论边核依据，不必再开一轮搜索。

### 2.2 信源选择本身就是可感知体验

引用 UI 相同，信源偏好不同，信任气质也会不同。Perplexity 案例记录的第三方统计对照很有用：ChatGPT 引用中 Wikipedia 占比可达 47.9%，Perplexity 更偏 Reddit（46.7%）与 30 天内新鲜内容（引用权重可达 3.2 倍）；同一品牌在两边被引用的域名重合度仅约 11%。这说明「权威」不是后台隐藏参数，而是用户能感觉到的产品差异——学术调研与「找真实体验帖」本就不该共用同一套信源默认值。夸克侧则用结果分栏（资讯、文档等）+ 来源卡片，把传统搜索的材料感保留在答案旁边，降低「AI 突然接管」的断裂感。

### 2.3 有引用 ≠ 答案正确

夸克案例写得很清楚，这也是横向文必须钉死的边界：

- 来源质量可能很差，或上下文被截断；
- 不同来源可能互相矛盾，而模型仍写成单一流畅结论；
- 结论可能超出证据范围（引用在，推理却漂了）。

因此引用解决的是可核验与可问责，不是事实保证。产品上更完整的信任包，至少还包括：证据不足时的拒...

# Perplexity citations UX: source chips & trust design

Perplexity’s trust model is evidence in the reading flow. Sourcing stays tied to claims as you scan, verification depth matches how skeptical you are, and you can challenge bad citations without leaving the answer. Feedback even treats wrong sources as a first-class failure mode, not an afterthought.

## Domain chips in the prose

### What works

- Chips show publisher domain first, users recognize ESPN vs FanDuel before clicking.
- +N communicates multiple sources for one claim without cluttering the sentence.
- Chips sit inline so skeptical readers spot sourcing while scanning bullets.

### What we would push on

- Domain abbreviations (sportsbook.fanduel) may confuse non-US users. Tooltip with full title helps.

### Product bet

Inline domain chips are Perplexity’s brand in the reading flow. Publisher-first labels build trust faster than footnote numbers and keep sourcing visible while users scan.

### Tradeoff

Decision | Benefit | Cost 
---|---|---
Publisher-first inline chips with +N count | Sourcing visible while scanning; recognizable domains | Abbreviated domains may confuse some users 

### Takeaway

Use publisher-first inline chips with a count, not footnotes at the bottom of the page.

Pattern:
...
## Steps show what was searched
...
- Research steps make retrieval visible, users see the system looked before asserting favorites.
- Expand/collapse keeps auditors happy without wall-of-log noise for casual readers.
- Step wording mirrors user mental model (Checking predictions) not API names.
...
- Steps do not list domains fetched, auditors still jump to Links or chips for specifics.
...
Showing retrieval happened before claims appear is table stakes for a search AI. Steps justify latency and differentiate Perplexity from chat models that answer from memory.
...
Decision | Benefit | Cost 
---|---|---
Collapsed research steps in plain language | Trust signal without log noise for casual readers | No domain list; auditors need Links or chips
...
Trust starts with showing retrieval happened. Then show which sources matter.
...
## Sources row on the answer block
...
- One glance shows how many sources backed the answer and which domains dominated.
- Sources row lives in the action bar, same elevation as copy and share, not footer debris.
- Count sets expectation before users open the full Links tab.
...
- Favicon stack truncates; users cannot see all ten without clicking through.
...
The sources summary row puts breadth on the answer chrome at the same elevation as share and copy. Users see “10 sources” before they commit to reading, which supports Perplexity’s cited-answer positioning.
...
Decision | Benefit | Cost 
---|---|---
Favicon stack and source count on answer bar | Global source breadth at a glance | Favicon stack truncates; full list needs click-through
...
Summarize source breadth on the answer chrome, inline chips for local, row for global.
...
## Links tab for full audit
...
- Links tab is a dedicated audit view, same query, every reference as a scannable card.
- Each card shows title, URL, snippet, and preview image before opening a new tab.
- Tab sits beside Answer and Images so audit does not require leaving the result.
...
- Users must discover the Links tab, no inline jump from a chip number to card N in list.
...
A full Links tab is the audit layer for skeptical users and power researchers. It keeps verification inside Perplexity instead of opening ten browser tabs from inline chips alone.
...
Decision | Benefit | Cost 
---|---|---
Links tab as peer tab beside Answer and Images | Full source browser without leaving the result | No inline jump from chip +N to card N in list
...
Offer a full source browser as a peer tab, not only hover cards on chips.
...
## Feedback includes Wrong sources
...
- Wrong sources separates citation failures from generic Inaccurate, routes triage correctly.
- Sits beside Out of date for stale odds/news, common on time-sensitive search.
- Optional chips keep the modal lightweight.
...
- No follow-up to mark which source was wrong, product learns less than per-citation flagging.
...
Wrong sources as a first-class chip trains retrieval quality directly. For a citation product, distinguishing bad sources from bad writing is core product signal, not a nice-to-have.
...
Decision | Benefit | Cost 
---|---|---
Wrong sources chip in negative feedback | Citation failures routable separately from Inaccurate | No per-source follow-up from the modal
...
Search products need source-specific negative feedback, not only “bad answer.”
...
## Check sources on a selection
...
- Users can challenge one paragraph , “Why this is still uncertain” , without re-running the whole query.
- Check sources pairs with Add to follow-up: verify vs iterate...

results.title: Perplexity (product review)
results.summary:
Perplexity
URL: https://www.perplexity.ai/
...
Perplexity combines large language models (LLMs) with live web search to provide current, sourced answers rather than generating text from stored knowledge. It specializes in real-time, citation-backed research as opposed to serving as a conversational partner [1].
...
Perplexity is a generative AI (artificial intelligence) powered search engine that uses machine learning and natural language processing to provide thorough answers to queries by searching the web for trusted sources and then synthesizing relevant information into a detailed response. Unlike traditional search engines which provide dozens of pages of links to explore individually, Perplexity provides answers in sentence form instantaneously [2]. Conversations are stored as Threads which include the initial question and all follow-up queries and responses.

There are two modes to choose from in the free version: Search and Research. Search is the default setting, designed for quicker and more concise responses to general questions (Figure 1).
...
When using the Search function, a response starts generating immediately (Figure 2).
...
Once a response is generated, a tab for Sources and a tab for Tasks appear. Clicking on Sources shows a list of all sources cited within the response (Figure 3) and clicking on Tasks provides an outline of what the AI did to retrieve the answer (Figure 4).
...
Citations are typically retrieved from a variety of websites and can also include library research guides, preprint servers, and other discipline-specific sources. It is possible journal articles will be included, but Research mode is preferable for retrieving scholarly works as it executes multiple searches and gathers information from across hundreds of sources [3]. Users also have the option to hover over Search and toggle the Pro version on to receive three Pro Search queries per day without upgrading to a paid subscription. Pro Search provides more detailed responses than Search mode by using multi-step reasoning to break down complex searches or prompts into steps for the AI to synthesize sources.

Research mode is intended for questions requiring longer and more in-depth responses and can be used up to three times per day with the free version (Figure 5).
...
When using the Research function, the AI explains each step of the process in first person statements as it searches and reads for information to answer the query. Once complete, this information can be found in the Tasks tab (Figure 6).
...
The list of sources is more extensive than that of Search mode with academic literature more prevalent, and may take upwards of five minutes to generate the comprehensive response [3].

In both modes, images and videos may also be retrieved depending on the question asked by the user and will be stored in the separate Images and Videos tabs. Free and paid account users can set the Search mode to search the Internet (default setting), academic papers, or social media discussions and opinions (Figure 7).
...
Perplexity works with both prompts and searches. Prompts are detailed, conversational commands, whereas searches are a set of keywords like those used in a search engine. Keywords can also be combined using Boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT). Prompts should be used when seeking more detailed explanations or specific content while searches are best for yielding broader results [4]. While both prompts and searches generate responses in paragraph format, a prompt response will be more in-depth. The default large language model (LLM) for searches is set to “Best” where the system chooses the most appropriate LLM for the query.
...
By citing sources that users can review and evaluate for themselves, it positions itself as a search engine that provides trustworthy answers.
...
The free version of Perplexity includes a variety of features and functions that may be advantageous for users based on preferred modes of information gathering.
...
- 10 text, audio, or video file uploads per day: upload from device, Google Drive, or Dropbox to receive summaries, transcription, brainstorming, coding, and more [5]
- Image generation: use prompts to generate images (browser only as of May 2025)
- Discover: browse topics from finance to entertainment and customize them according to personal preferences
- Spaces: create a Space and give the AI instructions that apply to every thread within it
- Dictation: dictate a query rather than typing it
- Voice Mode: ask questions by voice and the AI will respond orally
- Set your preferred language: select from a list of 21 available languages to be used in the interface and responses
- Appearance: choose between light and dark modes.
...
It has a desktop app for Mac and Windows and an iOS and Android app for mobile.
...
To access Perplexity’s primary features, users must create an account and sign in with Google, Apple, or email. The interface is intuitive and can be used across the web and desktop or mobile apps based on user preference.

results.title: Perplexity Platform Guide: Design for Citation-Forward Answers - Unusual - AI Brand Alignment
results.summary:
Perplexity is a citation-forward answer engine; most responses display numbered sources you can expand and click. Your objective is to make your pages the cleanest, most quotable evidence—short definition blocks, datum-dense mini-tables, explicit references, and HTML-first pages that parse cleanly.
...
#### How Perplexity Handles Sources (What to Design For)

Perplexity searches the live web, composes an answer, and shows numbered citations (and often a Sources panel) so users can verify claims. Because the UI foregrounds sources, definition clarity and reference density directly affect inclusion. (Perplexity Blog: “Getting started with Perplexity” — https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/blog/getting-started-with-perplexity)

#### What to Publish (Archetypes That Get Quoted)

Publish a model-ready canon and point this guide’s recommendations there:

Product overviews with capabilities, limits, and short examples.

Comparisons with a neutral, criteria-first table.

Pricing & eligibility with edge cases and definitions.

Security & compliance with controls, certifications, subprocessors.

Single-question FAQs (one intent per URL) with concise answers and references.

Perplexity’s emphasis on citations means each page benefits from a tight References section (primary data + reputable third parties) and a visible changelog/last updated to signal freshness. (Tom’s Guide overview of Perplexity’s citation-driven UX — https://www.tomsguide.com/ai/what-is-perplexity-ai)

#### Page Anatomy

Definition box (2–4 sentences): the short answer in plain language.

Mini decision table: when to choose A vs. B; include variables and examples.

Details: specs, steps, limits, worked examples.

References: primary sources and credible third-party confirmations.

Changelog: date, editor, what changed.

Perplexity routinely surfaces concise, quotable passages that justify an answer—make yours easy to lift verbatim. (Perplexity Help — “How does Perplexity work?” — cited above)

#### Formatting & Technical Hygiene

One intent per URL; stable, shallow slugs; canonical tags.

HTML-first (page readable with JS disabled); provide HTML twins for important PDFs.

Headings that reflect the task (“Definition,” “Comparison,” “Steps,” “References”).

Schema as scaffolding (FAQ/HowTo/Article/CaseStudy in JSON-LD) that matches on-page facts.

Explicit “last updated” and public “What’s New” roll-up to reinforce currency.

Third-party reviewers consistently note Perplexity’s focus on verifiable sources—clean, structured content improves your odds of being one of them. (Tom’s Guide feature explainers — https://www.tomsguide.com/ai/youre-using-perplexity-all-wrong-heres-how-to-get-the-most-out-of-the-ai-tool)

#### Enterprise Note: Internal + Web Evidence

If you use Perplexity Enterprise/Pro, you can allow Internal Knowledge Search so answers synthesize from both org files and the web (Web + Org Files mode). Maintain the same reference hygiene internally—single-intent docs, clear definitions, and dated updates—so Perplexity can safely blend sources.
...
What is Internal Knowledge Search” — https://www.perplexity.ai/help-center/en/articles/10352914-what-is-internal-knowledge-search)

#### Bridge the Gap From Citation to Pipeline

Add crawlable bridge modules near the top of pages likely to be cited:

Compare vs. X (prewritten, neutral comparison)

Pricing & Eligibility (request pricing/quote)

Security Review Pack (one-click due-diligence bundle)

Talk to an Expert (calendar embed tuned to the page’s intent)

Because users often open cited links in a new tab, make the next step obvious and low-friction. (Tom’s Guide commentary on Perplexity’s “answer-then-sources” flow — https://www.tomsguide.com/ai/ive-ditched-google-for-perplexity-heres-four-reasons-why)

#### Quick Inclusion Tests (15 Minutes Each)

Definition test: Ask Perplexity: “What is [your concept] and when should I choose it over [alternative]?” Expect your canonical URL among numbered sources; if missing, compare your definition clarity and reference density to cited pages.
...
Comparison test: Ask: “A vs. B for [use case]—what’s better and why?” Verify that your criteria-first table is being paraphrased...

重田信 ( GIZMODOライター )
ChatGPTやGeminiでもWebの情報を基に回答が生成できるようになりましたが、引用元が不明な回答や、あきらかに誤った内容を示されることもあります。

検索に特化したPerplexity（パープレキシティ）なら、必ず参照元のページを提示してくれるので、正確で大量のリサーチが可能になります。この記事では、Perplexityの特徴と使い方を紹介します。

結論：【Perplexity（パープレキシティ）の強み】

軽く質問するだけで、質の高い回答・関連情報を提案してくれる。

たとえば…

- 回答の上部に参照したWebサイトを表示
- 回答の最下部に最初の質問に関連した項目が表示されて、追加のプロンプト入力なしで深堀りしていける

## 検索エンジンを使うように利用できる

Perplexityでは、常に最新の情報を検索し、AIが回答を生成します。プロンプトを入力すると、回答よりも先に参照したWebサイトが表示されるのが特徴。

そのあとに続く回答の文の末尾には、参照したサイトの注釈が付きます。

生成された回答の下部にスクロールすると、関連した質問事項が表示され、追加のプロンプトを入力することなく調べたいことを深掘りすることができます。

### プロンプトなしで答えを再生成

さらに、「Rewrite」を選択すると、回答が再生成されます。ほかの情報源を参照したい場合に、プロンプトを入力する手間が省けます。

選択すると、再生成するAIを選択できますが、有料プランにアップグレードしないと適用できない場合もあります。

「Pro Search」を選択して再生成してみました。
...
## ChatGPTやGeminiとの違い

ちなみに、同じプロンプトをChatGPTやGeminiでも入力して回答の様子を比較してみました。

それぞれの生成AIならではの回答が詳しく生成されましたが、参照元のURLは提示されませんでした。

Perplexityなら「ソースを提示して」などのプロンプトを逐一入力する必要がないので、まさにリサーチに特化したAIといえそうです。

## ユーザー登録なし無料で使えるが回数制限あり

Perplexityは、アカウントを作成しなくてもすぐに使えるので、初心者にとってハードルの低い生成AIといえそうです。ただし、数回プロンプトを入力するとアカウントを作成しないと使えなくなってしまいます。

また、無料版では、高性能な回答は1日に5回までに制限されています。

有料版のProなら、高機能なAIによる回答の制限は600回と大幅に増え、GPT-4oやclaude-3など、回答を生成するAIを選択できるようになり、さらに快適に利用できます。

Perplexityは、無料版でも十分に活用できる便利なツールです。検索と生成AIの融合により、最新情報に触れながら、情報収集を効率化できるでしょう。

# AI citations UX compared: ChatGPT vs Perplexity sources design

Same trust job, two product bets: claim-level publisher chips with a Sources sidebar, versus citation-native research with Links audit and wrong-source feedback.
...
Perplexity treats citations as the product: domain chips, research steps, Links tab, selection Check sources, and Wrong sources in feedback. Steal ChatGPT’s progressive depth for chat; steal Perplexity’s audit and source-failure taxonomy for research AI.

## Side-by-side comparison
...
Dimension | ChatGPT | Perplexity
...
Inline citation chips 
Claim-level preview 
Full source audit 
Research transparency | 
No research-step UI; citations appear when the answer is web-grounded.

Source quality feedback | 
Standard thumbs feedback; no first-class “wrong sources” failure mode in the citation surface.

Product bet | 
Chat-first: progressive verification depth when the web is involved, without making citations the brand.

Research-first: evidence in the reading flow is the product, with audit and source-failure taxonomy.
...
Citations UX is how an AI product shows which sources support a claim: inline chips, hover previews, source lists, research steps, and feedback when sources are wrong. It is the primary trust surface for web-grounded and research answers.

## ChatGPT vs Perplexity: which citations UX is better?

Neither is universally better.
...
Perplexity optimizes citation-native research (chips, steps, Links audit, wrong-source feedback). Match the posture to whether you are a chat product or a research product.

## Should citations be inline chips or footnotes?

Both ChatGPT and Perplexity put publisher- or domain-first chips on the claim in the reading flow. Footnote-only lists at the bottom force skeptical readers to leave the claim. Pair inline chips with a full audit surface for heavy verification.

## When do you need Wrong sources feedback?

When sourcing quality is a first-class failure mode—research, news, finance, health. Perplexity treats wrong sources as feedback taxonomy.
...

# Perplexity AI怎么用 Perplexity联网搜索及引用来源查看技巧【评测】
Dec 18, 2025 pm 10:48 PM
Perplexity AI通过实时联网检索权威网页并标注引用来源提供可验证答案。操作包括默认联网搜索、识别Sources、多源比对、Focus模式限定范围及展开隐藏依据，全程支持溯源验证。

如果您希望快速获取准确、可验证的网络信息，Perplexity AI提供了一种区别于传统搜索引擎和通用大模型的回答方式。它通过实时联网抓取最新网页内容，并在答案中直接标注引用来源。以下是具体操作与查看技巧：

## 一、基础联网搜索操作

Perplexity默认启用实时联网功能，所有提问均自动触发全网检索，无需额外开启设置。其核心机制是将自然语言问题转化为高精度搜索查询，并从可信站点（如政府官网、学术平台、权威媒体）提取片段生成回答。

1、打开Perplexity官网或App，确保已登录账户。

2、在主搜索框中输入明确的问题，例如：“2025年欧盟碳关税实施细则有哪些变化？”

3、按下回车或点击搜索按钮，系统将在数秒内返回结构化回答及来源列表。

4、注意：中文提问时建议补充英文关键词（如“CBAM regulation”），可提升对国际政策类内容的召回准确率。

## 二、识别与定位引用来源

每个答案右侧或底部均附带“Sources”区域，列出被引用的原始网页链接。这些链接按相关性排序，且每条均标注了来源域名与页面标题，便于用户快速判断权威性与时效性。

1、在回答正文末尾找到“Sources”标题及下方链接区块。

2、点击任一链接旁的“View”按钮，可在新标签页中直接跳转至原始网页对应段落（部分支持锚点定位）。

3、重点观察域名后缀：优先确认是否来自.uspto.gov、.wipo.int、gov.uk、nih.gov等权威后缀，避免依赖仅含.com或无备案信息的站点。

4、若某条引用显示“PDF”图标，说明该来源为可下载文档，点击即可获取原始文件用于深度核查。

## 三、筛选与验证多源信息

当一个问题存在多个解释角度或争议观点时，Perplexity会主动聚合不同立场的信源，帮助用户横向比对。此功能依赖于其底层检索策略对语义冲突内容的识别能力。

1、输入含对比意图的问题，例如：“DeepMind的Gemini与OpenAI的GPT-4o在代码生成任务上的实测差异”。

2、浏览回答中出现的并列陈述，如“A研究指出…，而B报告认为…”。

3、分别点击对应句子后的数字角标（如[1][3]），跳转至各自来源，核对其发布机构、作者资质与数据采集时间。

4、关键提示：若同一结论被三个以上独立权威来源交叉印证（如Nature子刊、IEEE会议论文、官方技术白皮书），则该信息可信度显著提高。

## 四、利用“Focus”模式限定搜索范围

Perplexity提供多种聚焦模式，可强制限制检索来源类型，从而提升专业领域结果的纯度。该功能适用于科研、法律、医疗等对信息出处要求极高的场景。

1、在搜索框右侧点击“Focus”下拉菜单。

2、选择预设选项，如“Academic”（仅学术论文）、“News”（近7天新闻）、“Reddit”（社区讨论）或“YouTube”（视频字幕提取）。

3、重新提交相同问题，观察回答中引用来源是否全部符合所选类别。

4、特别注意：“Academic”模式下返回的文献若未标注DOI号或期刊名称，需手动核查是否为预印本（如arXiv）而非正式发表成果。

## 五、追溯未被直接引用但影响结论的信息

部分复杂问题的回答中，某些支撑性事实未以显式角标形式出现在正文，但仍被纳入推理过程。Perplexity允许用户展开隐藏依据，实现更彻底的溯源。

1、在回答区域右上角寻找“⋯”更多选项按钮。

2、点击后选择“Show reasoning”或“See full context”（界面文字可能因版本略有差异）。

3、系统将展开一段灰色底纹文本，其中包含未被最终摘要采用但参与决策的原始...

# 如何在Perplexity中开启搜索结果的引用摘要预览_在设置中调整Citation Style
...
发布时间：2026-04-28 14:36:36
...
来源于php中文网

原创
Perplexity中需启用Sources模式并配置引文样式以显示引用摘要预览：一、通过Focus菜单选择Sources/Academic/Research模式；二、在Settings→Citations & References中设默认格式并勾选显示元数据；三、用自然语言指令临时指定MLA/APA等格式；四、Pro用户可用Cite按钮导出BibTeX/RIS。

如果您在Perplexity中查看搜索结果时未看到引用摘要的预览样式，或希望调整引用显示格式以匹配学术写作规范，则可能是由于当前未启用引用增强模式或未配置对应引文样式。以下是实现引用摘要预览开启与Citation Style调整的具体操作路径：

## 一、启用Sources模式以强制显示引用摘要预览

Perplexity仅在特定搜索焦点下默认激活引用摘要预览功能，该模式会自动将每条回答与来源链接绑定，并在回答末尾聚合可展开的Sources区块，确保用户能即时预览引用出处及关键元数据。

1、打开Perplexity.ai官网或App主界面，确保已登录账户。

2、在搜索框上方找到标有“Focus”字样的下拉菜单按钮。

3、从菜单中选择Sources、Academic或Research任一模式。

4、输入问题并提交，新生成的回答将自动附带编号引用标记及底部Sources区域，点击右侧箭头即可展开摘要预览。

## 二、通过设置页面全局启用引用样式偏好

Perplexity支持在账户级设置中指定默认引用格式（如APA第7版、MLA第9版、Chicago作者-日期制），该设置会影响Sources卡片中元数据显示结构及导出内容字段顺序，但不改变网页端实时摘要预览的视觉样式。

1、点击界面右上角用户头像，进入Settings设置中心。

2、在左侧导航栏中选择Citations & References选项。

3、在“Default Citation Style”下拉列表中，选择目标格式，例如APA 7th Edition或GB/T 7714—2015。

4、勾选Show citation metadata in Sources cards复选框，使每条引用卡片显示作者、年份、标题、URL等字段。
...
## 三、使用快捷指令临时覆盖默认引用样式

当单次查询需适配特定期刊或课程要求时，可通过自然语言指令覆盖全局设置，直接触发Perplexity按指定格式组织引用信息并嵌入摘要预览上下文。

1、在搜索框中输入指令："Please answer with sources shown in MLA 9th edition format"。

2、换行后粘贴具体问题，例如：“What are the primary diagnostic criteria for long COVID according to WHO 2025 guidelines?”。

3、提交后，Sources区块内每条链接将按MLA格式标注作者缩写、斜体期刊名、出版年份及页码范围（若可提取）。

4、若结果未完整呈现，追加提问：“Rewrite all source citations above using APA 7th edition, including DOIs where available.”。

## 四、Pro用户启用Cite按钮获取结构化引用导出

Perplexity Pro订阅用户可在部分高信源卡片上直接调用Cite功能，该按钮生成的BibTeX或RIS数据已预置所选Citation Style字段映射，适用于Zotero、EndNote等文献管理工具批量导入，实现引用摘要预览与本地写作环境的无缝衔接。

1、在Sources区块中识别带有PDF图标或DOI标识的条目。

2、将鼠标悬停于该卡片右上角，出现Cite按钮后点击。

3、在弹出窗口中确认当前选定的引用样式是否与Settings中一致，若不符则手动切换。

4、选择导出格式（BibTeX/RIS），下载文件后可用文本编辑器验证author、title、journal、year、doi等字段是否按所选样式排布。
